title: adzuki-snp-pipeline parameters
description: Parameter contract for the adzuki SNP-calling pipeline

input.description: CSV samplesheet containing paired-end WGS inputs

reference_id.description: Stable identifier for the reference bundle

bwa_index_prefix.description: Optional BWA-MEM2 index prefix; basename must match reference_fasta

sample_ploidy.description: Global sample ploidy for the whole run, passed to both GATK HaplotypeCaller and GenotypeGVCFs; applies uniformly to every sample and contig, not per-sample or per-contig

enable_gs_panel.description: Whether to run the GS (genomic selection) SNP panel lineage; its schema v1 is diploid-only, so this must be false whenever sample_ploidy is not 2

optical_duplicate_pixel_distance.description: Maximum pixel distance between read clusters for GATK MarkDuplicates to call them optical (rather than PCR/library) duplicates; the default (100) matches GATK's own unmodified default and is appropriate for unpatterned flowcells, but should be raised (commonly to ~2500) for patterned flowcells (e.g. HiSeq X, NovaSeq) per GATK/Picard guidance

genomicsdb_batch_size.description: Batch size passed to GATK GenomicsDBImport's --batch-size, controlling how many samples it opens concurrently while building the workspace; 50 is a current initial operational value carried over from GATK's own tooling conventions, not a value validated against this pipeline's target 327-sample cohort or any intermediate 20-30 sample scale

containers.description: Issue #52: single default-value source of truth for the GS-lineage processes' container image references (see conf/containers.config). Each process's own effective container (Nextflow's task.container, resolved after any override) is what actually gets recorded in the GS panel manifest -- this default is not itself trusted as provenance. Not intended to be set via the CLI/samplesheet in normal use; change conf/containers.config directly to bump a pinned image.

bcftools.description: Default bcftools image reference for the GS lineage's bcftools-based processes

gatk.description: Default GATK image reference for the GS lineage's GATK-based processes

python.description: Default Python image reference for the GS lineage's Python-based processes
